8 22 58] Mahābhārata [Karnavadha Parva
C 8 1318 B 8 31 68 K 8 22 72

In every way, I shall conquer all the Pāṇḍavas who have gathered here today. 58
Duryodhana said:
I will do all that you suggest, Karṇa. The chariots, equipped with quivers, will surely follow you, O son of a charioteer. 59
Let those carts carry arrows with iron heads and feathered shafts.

<column-break/>

We, along with all the kings, will follow you, Karṇa. 60
Sañjaya said:
Having said this, O great king, your son, who is full of majesty, approached the king of the Madras and spoke these words. 61

->Thus ends the twenty-second chapter in the Karṇa Parva of the blessed Mahābhārata. 22<-

---

## 23

Sañjaya said:
Your son, O great king, approached the king of the Madras with humility and, out of affection, spoke these words: 1
O one of true vows, O most fortunate one, O you who increase the sin of your enemies.

<summary>Duryodhana expresses his resolve to defeat the Pāṇḍavas and confirms his intent to support Karṇa with his full military forces, leading to the conclusion of the twenty-second chapter and the beginning of the twenty-third.</summary>
